name: codecall
description: Quiz on the code your agent just wrote, trace a request flow, or practise a debugging round with a planted bug.

interface.shortDescription: Understand the code your agent writes, and practise debugging rounds.
interface.longDescription: After Codex builds something, codecall teaches the 2 to 4 ideas behind the change using your own code and checks you can explain them. It can also trace one request flow file by file, or plant one realistic bug for a debugging drill and restore your code with Git. Always asks first; no API key, nothing uploaded.
defaultPrompt: Teach me the implementation I just completed with Codecall.
Trace the login request with Codecall.
Run a medium Codecall debugging drill on this project.
